items.title: Rental Depreciation
items.summary: Synthetic Dynamics 365 CE backlog used to test the dynamics-365-ce adapter. Not a real project backlog.

items.title: Depreciation (CFG) - Create Global Choices

use_case: Rental administrators need standard depreciation classifications so that every pricing class is set up the same way.
Rental administrators need to enable or disable automatic validation of depreciation rules per pricing class.
The depreciation calculation logic needs fixed reference values so that it can branch on the selected type.
outcomes: Create the depreciation global choices in the Rental solution in CO DEVL.
Deploy the Rental solution to the upper CO environments for testing.
Deploy the Rental solution to Rental DEVL for customization.

technical_details.text: t1: CO DEVL -> Rental -> Global Choices:

children: Description: Classifies how a pricing class depreciates.
Description: Sets how often a fixed depreciation run occurs.
Target environments: CO TEST, CO PROD.
Target environment for customization: Rental DEVL.

acceptance_criteria: The global choice Rental Depreciation Types will exist in the Rental solution in CO DEVL with the choices Fixed, Activity, and Hybrid.
The global choice Rental Fixed Depreciation Frequency will exist in the Rental solution in CO DEVL with the choices Monthly and Weekly.
The Rental solution will be deployed to the upper CO environments for testing.
The Rental solution will be deployed to the Rental DEVL environment for customization.

items.title: Depreciation (DEV) - Plugin: Do depreciation calculation by type

use_case: The rental business needs equipment depreciation calculated automatically when a depreciation line is created, so that no administrator computes values by hand.
Each depreciation type needs its own calculation method, so that fixed and activity pricing classes produce correct values.
The Equipment record needs its remaining value kept current, because rental pricing and reporting read that value.
outcomes: Create a plug-in that runs when a Rental Depreciation Line is created.
Select the calculation method from the pricing class configuration.
Update the Equipment record and the triggering depreciation line with the calculated values.

children.text: Retrieve from the Pricing Class (jd_rentaldepreciationlog > jd_pricingclass):

children: Write no value and exit without error.

children.text: IF the calculated value is below "Depreciation Floor":
children: Set the calculated value to "Depreciation Floor".
Update the Equipment column "MDP Less Depreciation" (jd_mdplessdepreciation).
Update the triggering Rental Depreciation Line with the calculated amount.
Dependency: t1 and the helper library in t4.

acceptance_criteria: A plug-in will exist that is registered on the Create message of the Rental Depreciation Line table in the Post Operation stage, running synchronously.
When the pricing class Depreciation Type is Fixed, the plug-in will call CalculateDepreciationByCost.
When the pricing class Activity Depreciation Sub-Type is Revenue, the plug-in will call CalculateDepreciationByRentalRevenuePercent.
When neither branch matches, the plug-in will exit without writing a value and without raising an error.
The plug-in will update the "MDP Less Depreciation" (jd_mdplessdepreciation) value on the Equipment record.
The plug-in will update the calculated amount on the Rental Depreciation Line that triggered it.
The plug-in assembly will be deployed to the Rental solution in CO DEVL.

items.title: Depreciation (INT) - Power Automate: Scheduled depreciation calculation

use_case: Dealers need depreciation calculated on a schedule, so that fixed pricing classes are processed without manual work.
Each dealer needs the run to follow its own configured scheduling preference.
The depreciation custom action needs a caller, because nothing else triggers a fixed-type run.
outcomes: Create a scheduled Power Automate flow in the Rental solution.
Read the dealer scheduling configuration from the Rental Settings record.
Call the depreciation custom action with the eligible pricing classes.

technical_details.text: t5: Create a Power Automate Flow:
children: Trigger: Schedule, daily at 4:00 AM Eastern

children.text: Retrieve columns from the Rental Settings record:
IF "Rental Depreciation Schedule Strategy" == "First of month":
children: IF today is not the first day of the month, escape the flow.

children.text: ELSE IF "Rental Depreciation Schedule Strategy" == "Day of month":
children: IF today does not match "Rental Depreciation Day", escape the flow.
Escape the flow, because no other strategy is defined.
Call custom action jd_GenerateRentalDepreciationLogs with the retrieved pricing class identifiers.
On failure, record the run outcome on the Rental Settings record and notify the rental operations mailbox.
Re-running on the same day creates no duplicate depreciation log.
Dependency: the custom API in t6.

acceptance_criteria: A Power Automate flow will exist in the Rental solution with a schedule trigger that runs daily at 4:00 AM Eastern.
The flow will read the four scheduling columns from the Rental Settings record on every run.
When the schedule strategy is First of month and today is not the first day, the flow will escape without calling the custom action.
When the schedule strategy is Day of month and today does not match the configured day, the flow will escape without calling the custom action.
When the schedule conditions are met, the flow will retrieve every Pricing Class where Depreciation Type is Fixed and depreciation rules are validated.
The flow will pass the retrieved pricing class identifiers to jd_GenerateRentalDepreciationLogs.
A second run on the same day will create no duplicate depreciation log.
A failed run will notify the rental operations mailbox.
